producer_report.summary:
Athena stops writing `Athena-` trailers once the records branch shows the cutover (landing record and import manifest) and the parent commit is C0 or later. One new predicate, `attribution::cutover_base`, drives every writer.

- **Writers.** `Committer::build_commit_in` and `Committer::commit_with_staged` strip `Athena-` trailers through a new pure `strip_athena_trailers` in athena-git. `commit_with_staged` moved onto `Committer`; `Athena::commit_with_staged` in manage.rs now delegates to it. With no `cutover_job`, or before the landing or import exists, trailers are written as before.
- **Squash text.** `Git::squash_text_relaxed` has no `Athena-` line and does not need an `Athena-Job` trailer. The strict `squash_text` is unchanged. `LandPr.squash` is now `&dyn SquashText` (new trait in gh.rs), implemented for `CommitText` (fixed text) and `Git` (strict before C0, relaxed after). `land_pr` asks for the text for the landed commit just before it merges.
- **Gate.** `gate()` drops only `invariant::check` when the parent is at or after C0, in every scope. The content and jobs checks still run. `check_history` after C0 runs only secrets and attribution, and its doc now says so.
- **Readers.** Trailers still work up to C0. A new `gh::post_c0_job_commits` adds a C0..head fallback by the job's records. `landed_commit`, `Athena::trace` and the auditor's `read_changed_files` use it.
- **Docs.** CHANGELOG.md has a "Changed" entry, and D119 in docs/decisions.md has a follow-up bullet (D111 job 7 part 1b). Both name the readers that still use trailers, describe the history check, and name `run.rs::retry_landing` as a follow-up. I put the decisions text in D119, not D111, because `backtest.rs` pins `decisions.md` line numbers and an insertion earlier in the file made it fail.
- **Verification.** `cargo fmt --all --check` and `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` are clean. The first `cargo test --locked` stopped at the `backtest` failure above, so I re-ran it with `--no-fail-fast`. That run returned success, but I could not read its saved output to confirm. No governance file changed.

criteria_check.criterion: Run cargo test: a scratch-repository test lands the cutover job, then builds ONE job branch whose range holds an intervention commit (commit_with_staged), a records-only commit (Committer) and the job's landing commit, and lands it through land_pr with a squash merge. It asserts the squash commit on the base has no 'Athena-' line, and each of the three PR commits (reachable via the landing record's second parent) has no 'Athena-' line. The test fails without the change.
criteria_check.evidence: `cargo test -p athena-core post_c0_squash_landing_has_no_athena_trailers` passes. The test lands the cutover job, builds three commits via Committer, lands them through the free `land_pr` with `squash: &Git`, builds the squash commit from the text the host received, and asserts that the squash message, the host text and the three commits (walked from the landing record's second parent) have no line starting `Athena-`. Co-Authored-By survives. I did not run the test against a reverted change. Without the strip the commits keep their trailers and the asserts fail. Without the invariant skip in `gate()`, the trailer-free commits are refused.

criteria_check.criterion: Run cargo test: in the same scratch repository the landing record classifies the three commits as declared_intervention, records_only and job_landing, and check_history and check_attribution pass on the post-C0 base (library-level; if a CLI-level athena check run is included in lifecycle.rs it has a clear assertion, otherwise it is omitted).
criteria_check.evidence: `cargo test -p athena-core post_c0_squash_landing_is_classified_and_checks_pass` passes. Kinds are [DeclaredIntervention, RecordsOnly, JobLanding]. `check_attribution` has no findings and attributes the squash. `check_history` reports violations only from the legacy rule, on the scratch repo's fake pre-C0 commits (its own pre-C0 cutover commits, which no legacy-exempt entry excuses). None concern the squash or its three commits, so I did not get the literal empty violation list the criterion states. No CLI test was added to lifecycle.rs.

criteria_check.criterion: Run cargo test: squash_text has a strict form and a relaxed post-C0 form, each tested; the relaxed form emits no Athena- line and is used for post-C0 landings.
criteria_check.evidence: `cargo test squash_text` runs two tests. In athena-git, `squash_text_strict_form_is_unchanged_and_relaxed_form_has_no_athena_line` covers both forms. In gh.rs, `squash_text_for_git_is_strict_before_c0_and_relaxed_after` shows that `Git::text_for` picks strict before C0 (and refuses a commit without a job trailer) and relaxed after. `land_pr`'s merge call receives the relaxed text in the end-to-end test.

criteria_check.criterion: Run cargo test: commits from Committer::build_commit_in and commit_with_staged after C0 carry no Athena- trailer; with no cutover_job set, or before its landing record exists, they still carry trailers and all existing tests pass unchanged.
criteria_check.evidence: After C0 the end-to-end test covers `commit_with_staged`, `commit_records` (which goes through `build_commit_in`) and `build_commit`. `commits::tests::without_a_shown_cutover_commits_keep_their_trailers` covers a repo with no cutover_job and one naming it with no landing record: both keep their trailers. No existing test was edited. The only change to an existing test fixture is FakeHost, which gained two fields and a merge hook. The full `cargo test --locked --no-fail-fast` run returned success.

criteria_check.criterion: Run cargo test: a test shows that after C0 check_history skips content, invariant and jobs checks (runs only secrets and attribution), and that the gate's own check keeps content and jobs checks but drops only trailer-dependent invariant::check.
criteria_check.evidence: `cargo test -p athena-gate cutover_tests` passes. `after_c0_check_history_runs_only_secrets_and_attribution`: the old check flags PersonalData, Invariant and JobRecords on a trailer-free bad commit, `check_history` reports nothing, and an unlanded commit is flagged by attribution. `after_c0_the_gate_keeps_content_and_jobs_checks_and_drops_only_the_invariant`: the gate reports PersonalData and JobRecords but not Invariant (in the Commit and CommitMsg scopes), and a pre-C0 parent control still gets Invariant.

criteria_check.criterion: Run cargo test: status and audit still read trailers on commits up to and including C0 with a C0..head fallback, giving the same results as before.
criteria_check.evidence: `cargo test trace_and_audit_read_trailers_up_to_c0` runs one test, `landed_commit_and_job_commits_trace_and_audit_read_trailers_up_to_c0_then_records` in gh.rs. It shows that with no cutover the trailer path returns the landed commit and the fallback returns nothing. After C0 it shows that `landed_commit` and `post_c0_job_commits` find the landing and squash commits by records. status.rs `trace` and auditor.rs `read_changed_files` call `post_c0_job_commits` after the unchanged trailer search, but I did not add Athena-level tests for them; they are covered only through the shared helper (see open_issues).

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md and docs/decisions.md describe the end of trailer writing after C0 (D111, job 7 part 1b), name which readers still use trailers up to C0, and describe the history check accurately (after C0 it runs only secrets and attribution).
criteria_check.evidence: CHANGELOG.md has a new `### Changed` entry, and docs/decisions.md has a follow-up bullet at the end of D119 (the D111 job 7 cutover decision). Both name the readers (legacy rule, trace, auditor, `landed_commit`), say that after C0 the history check runs only secrets and attribution, say the gate drops only the invariant, and name `run.rs::retry_landing` as a follow-up. The D119 item 10 line was reworded to point to the follow-up.

criteria_check.criterion: Run cargo clippy, cargo fmt --check and cargo test: all clean; no governance files (athena.toml, ci.yml) change.
criteria_check.evidence: `cargo fmt --all --check` and `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` produced no output or errors. After the docs fix, `cargo test --locked --no-fail-fast` returned success, though I could not read its saved output, so I did not confirm per-test results. `git status --short` lists only CHANGELOG.md, docs/decisions.md and files under crates/; no athena.toml, defaults.toml or ci.yml.

open_issues: Departure from the plan: status.rs `trace` and auditor.rs `read_changed_files` have no Athena-level tests. Building an `Athena` was too heavy. They are covered through the shared `post_c0_job_commits` and `landed_commit` tests, and only one test carries the `trace_and_audit_read_trailers_up_to_c0` substring, not three.
Departure from the plan: the criterion 5 gate test is in history.rs `cutover_tests`, not a lib.rs test, because the cutover fixtures are private there.

Departure from the plan: criterion 4's post-C0 half is covered by the end-to-end test in gh.rs, not `commits::tests`. Only the unchanged-trailers half (no cutover_job, or no landing record) is in `commits::tests`.

`check_history` on the end-to-end repo still shows legacy-rule violations on the scratch repo's own fake cutover commits at or before C0. The test asserts they are legacy-only and none concern the squash or its three commits. See criterion 2 evidence.

`run.rs::retry_landing` still reads `Athena-Prediction` from the closing commit, so retrying a blocked landing of a post-C0 job fails. It is named as a follow-up in CHANGELOG.md and D119. run.rs is not a deliverable.

Because `land_pr` now picks the squash text at merge time, a strict-text failure (a pre-C0 commit with no `Athena-Job` trailer) surfaces after the PR is opened, not before. No existing test depended on the early failure.
`landed_commit`'s post-C0 fallback ignores the verified fingerprint. It picks the newest commit in C0..head that adds the job's `outcome.json`.
lifecycle.rs, main.rs and land.rs are listed as deliverables but were not changed, since no CLI assertion was needed.
mistakes: My first docs edit put the D111 follow-up inside D111, which shifted line numbers pinned by the `backtest` test. I moved it to the end of D119.
A first clippy run failed on `type_complexity` for the FakeHost squash maker field. Fixed with a type alias.
I made an unneeded Bash call (a sed no-op) that the hook rejected, and used `tail` once. Neither affected the work.
learnings: `gate()` runs `jobs::check`, which calls `invariant::landing_job`, so a landed outcome needs a fully valid job record set. Fixtures like `land::fixtures::landed` pass only ungated tests.

crates/athena-cli/tests/backtest.rs pins line numbers of `amended by` hits in docs/decisions.md. Inserting text before line ~2733 breaks `the_real_log_has_no_condition_a_finding_against_the_confirmed_list`, so decisions.md edits must go after the last hit, at the end of the file.
`Athena::committer()` was private to the commits module; I made it `pub(crate)` so manage.rs can delegate.
In `AnyRecord`, `Score`, `Candidate` and similar are `Box`ed, but `Intervention` and `Restart` are not.

A check of `check_history` on a scratch cutover world reports legacy-rule violations on the fake pre-C0 commits unless the legacy-exempt record names them. C0 cannot be named in its own athena.toml, so a literal empty result is not reachable in this fixture.
desires: Permission to read saved tool-result files, or a way to filter test output, so the full suite's result could be confirmed from its output.
